name: merge-bar
description: The pull-request lifecycle against a merge bar fixed when the PR opens. Open a PR whose body carries seven fields (Claim, Scope, Known limits, Merge danger, Merge bar, Evidence, Closes); work it by sorting every reviewer finding as blocking or non-blocking against that bar, one push per round, with a stop at round 3 when the fixes are generating the findings, and non-blocking findings answered in the thread or recorded as known limits in the paired AI workspace's tech-debt ledger instead of filed as issues; review a PR as defect classes with every site, each sorted against that bar, in two parallel fresh-context axes (standards, and the Claim or spec), round 2+ on the fix diff only; and teach a repository's reviewers the bar through an AGENTS.md Code Review Rules section and, on public repositories, a .coderabbit.yaml. Four prose skills, four slash commands, no lib, no state.

interface.shortDescription: Open and work PRs against a merge bar fixed at open time
interface.longDescription: Opens pull requests with a seven-field body whose Merge bar says which findings can block and whose Merge danger says whether a revert undoes the merge, works each PR by sorting reviewer findings against that bar with one push per round and a round-3 stop, records non-blocking edge cases in a tech-debt ledger instead of filing issues, and sets up a repository's reviewers with AGENTS.md Code Review Rules.
